# Synthetic Anthropic unary cases

Every response in `cases.json` is synthetic: it was written for this suite, is not a
recorded or upstream fixture, and makes no claim about what the live Anthropic API
sends. `expected-results.jsonl` is generated by running the registered upstream
`@ai-sdk/anthropic` `doGenerate` over each response, so the upstream package is the
oracle. Each line holds the projected result (content, finish reason, usage, provider
metadata, warnings) or `callError` when upstream fails the call. Regenerate with
`mise run generate-conformance`.
